key_change_from_v1: V1's 'PAIRABLE' disposition is reclassified as 'HEURISTIC_CANDIDATE'. The heuristic generates candidates; it does NOT decide scientific eligibility. Custodian must independently adjudicate each pair using the A-G questions.

adjudication_questions.A: Is there a real mechanistic relationship? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.C: Is there a plausible transferable mechanism? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.D: Is the relationship already explicitly established? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.E: Can the pair generate a non-trivial discovery question? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.F: Is it sufficiently difficult that a competent scientist cannot trivially answer? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)
adjudication_questions.G: Does it create a legitimate discovery opportunity? (YES/NO/UNCERTAIN)

task_types.W-TASK: Can TEE discover a non-obvious relationship? (includes retrospective)
task_types.S-TASK: Can TEE generate a world-novel hypothesis not in literature?
task_types.REJECT: Pair does not qualify for benchmark

acceptance_rule: A=YES, B=YES, C=YES, E=YES, F=YES, G=YES → candidate benchmark pair
note: D=YES does not disqualify, but classifies as W-TASK (rediscovery) not S-TASK (world-novel).
negative_result_check: If custodian adjudicates <100 qualifying pairs, report NEGATIVE_RESULT.
